GAP LE Exported Types

group GAP_LE_Exported_Types

Enums

enum T_GAP_LE_PARAM_TYPE

GAP LE Parameter Types.

Values:

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEV_STATE

GAP device state. Read only. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_DEV_STATE.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_APPEARANCE

Local Device's Appearance. Read/Write. Size is 2 octets. Value is GAP Appearance Values. Default value is GAP_GATT_APPEARANCE_UNKNOWN.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEVICE_NAME

Local Device's Name. Write only. Maximum name string length is GAP_DEVICE_NAME_LEN. Default value is 'GAP'.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_SLAVE_INIT_GATT_MTU_REQ

Whether to initiate the GATT exchange MTU procedure once a connection is established when link role is Peripheral. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_RANDOM_ADDR

Random address. Write only. Size is 6 octets GAP_BD_ADDR_LEN.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_LATEST_CONN_BD_ADDR

Latest remote connected Bluetooth device address. Read only. Size is 6 octets GAP_BD_ADDR_LEN.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_LATEST_CONN_BD_ADDR_TYPE

Latest remote connected Bluetooth device address type. Read only. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_HANDLE_CREATE_CONN_IND

Whether to enable APP to handle create connection indication message when link role is Peripheral. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEFAULT_PHYS_PREFER

Preferred values for the transmitter PHY and receiver PHY to be used for all connections over the LE transport. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Value is Preference among the PHYs. Default value is GAP_PHYS_PREFER_ALL.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEFAULT_TX_PHYS_PREFER

The transmitter PHYs that the Host prefers the Controller to use. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Value is Preference among the PHYs. Default value is GAP_PHYS_PREFER_ALL.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEFAULT_RX_PHYS_PREFER

The receiver PHYs that the Host prefers the Controller to use. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Value is Preference among the PHYs. Default value is GAP_PHYS_PREFER_ALL.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_USE_EXTENDED_ADV

Whether to use LE Advertising Extensions. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEFAULT_DATA_LEN_MAX_TX_OCTETS

The Host's suggested value for the Controller's maximum transmitted number of payload octets in LL Data PDUs. Write only. Size is 2 octets. Value range: 0x001B to 0x00FB.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DEFAULT_DATA_LEN_MAX_TX_TIME

The Host's suggested value for the Controller's maximum packet transmission time in microseconds for packets containing LL Data PDUs. Write only. Size is 2 octets. Value range: 0x0148 to 0x4290. Units: microsecond.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_LOCAL_FEATURES

Local supported features. Read only. Size is 8 octets GAP_LE_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_LEN.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DS_POOL_ID

Downstream Pool ID. Read only. Size is 2 octets.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_DS_DATA_OFFSET

Downstream pool buffer data offset. Read only. Size is 2 octets.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_LE_REMAIN_CREDITS

Remaining credits available for TX. Read only. Size is 1 octet.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_MAX_WL_SIZE

Maximum Filter Accept List size. Read only. Size is 1 octet.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_MIN_TX_POWER

The minimum transmit powers supported by the Controller. Read only. Size is 1 octet. Range: -127 to +20. Units: dBm.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_MAX_TX_POWER

The maximum transmit powers supported by the Controller. Read only. Size is 1 octet. Range: -127 to +20. Units: dBm.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_CIS_HOST_SUPPORT

Whether to use CIS of LE Isochronous Channels. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_MASTER_INIT_GATT_MTU_REQ

Whether to initiate the GATT exchange MTU procedure once a connection is established when link role is Central. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 1 (enabled).
